name: Ciletuh Geopark Run 2027
short_description: A half-marathon held on January 17, 2027 at Pantai Palangpang, Sukabumi, Indonesia, offering 21.1km, 10km, and 5km distances.
ai_summary: Ciletuh Geopark Run 2027 is a half-marathon event scheduled for January 17, 2027, at Pantai Palangpang in Sukabumi, Jawa Barat, Indonesia. Organized by the Ministry of Tourism as part of its 'Geopark Run Series,' the event offers three distance options: 21.1km, 10km, and 5km. Registration details have not yet been announced. Runners can look forward to a race set against the scenic Ciletuh Geopark coastal backdrop.

core_facts.organizer: Kementerian Pariwisata (Ministry of Tourism) — 'Geopark Run Series'

faqs.question: What distances can I run in this event?
faqs.answer: The Ciletuh Geopark Run 2027 offers three distance categories for participants to choose from: a 21.1km half-marathon, which serves as the primary distance, a 10km race, and a shorter 5km option, catering to a variety of runner experience levels and goals.

faqs.question: Who organizes the Ciletuh Geopark Run?
faqs.answer: This event is organized by the Kementerian Pariwisata, Indonesia's Ministry of Tourism, as part of its broader 'Geopark Run Series,' which appears to be a program of races held at notable geopark locations across the country, including this one in Sukabumi.

faqs.question: Is registration open for the 2027 race?
faqs.answer: As of now, the registration status for the Ciletuh Geopark Run 2027 has not yet been announced. Prospective participants will need to watch for official updates from the Ministry of Tourism regarding when and how sign-ups will become available.

faqs.question: Where does the race take place?
faqs.answer: The race takes place at Pantai Palangpang, a beach location in Sukabumi, Jawa Barat, Indonesia. This venue sits within the Ciletuh Geopark area, giving the event its name and providing a coastal backdrop for the half-marathon, 10km, and 5km courses.
